concepts.name: Limits in Calculus
concepts.description: Fundamental concept of approaching a value in calculus.

concepts.name: Derivatives
concepts.description: Rate of change of a function with respect to its variable.

concepts.name: Integrals
concepts.description: Accumulation of quantities and area under curves.

concepts.name: Vectors
concepts.description: Objects with magnitude and direction used in many fields.

concepts.name: Matrices
concepts.description: Rectangular arrays representing linear transformations.

concepts.name: Basic Probability
concepts.description: Foundations of random events and likelihood.

concepts.name: Descriptive Statistics
concepts.description: Techniques to summarize and describe data sets.

concepts.name: Differential Equations
concepts.description: Equations involving derivatives that model dynamic systems.

concepts.name: Programming Basics
concepts.description: Fundamental concepts of writing and executing code.

concepts.name: Data Structures
concepts.description: Organized ways to store and access data efficiently.

concepts.name: Sorting Algorithms
concepts.description: Methods to arrange data in a particular order.

concepts.name: Graph Algorithms
concepts.description: Techniques for traversing and analyzing graph structures.

concepts.name: Computer Architecture
concepts.description: Design and organization of computer hardware components.

concepts.name: Operating Systems
concepts.description: Software that manages hardware resources and provides services to programs.

concepts.name: SQL Databases
concepts.description: Relational database management using Structured Query Language.

concepts.name: Introduction to Machine Learning
concepts.description: Overview of algorithms that enable computers to learn from data.

concepts.name: Supervised Learning
concepts.description: Learning paradigm using labeled examples to predict outcomes.

concepts.name: Linear Regression
concepts.description: Statistical method for modeling the relationship between variables.

concepts.name: Neural Networks
concepts.description: Computational models inspired by biological neuron connections.

concepts.name: Backpropagation
concepts.description: Algorithm for training neural networks by propagating errors backward.

concepts.name: Convolutional Neural Networks
concepts.description: Neural networks specialized for processing grid-like data such as images.

concepts.name: Reinforcement Learning
concepts.description: Learning framework where agents maximize cumulative reward through interaction.

concepts.name: Classical Mechanics
concepts.description: Study of motion of bodies under forces using Newtonian principles.

concepts.name: Energy Conservation
concepts.description: Principle that total energy in an isolated system remains constant.

concepts.name: Thermodynamics
concepts.description: Branch dealing with heat, work, and the laws governing energy transfer.

concepts.name: Electromagnetism
concepts.description: Theory describing electric and magnetic fields and their interactions.

concepts.name: Quantum Mechanics
concepts.description: Fundamental theory of physics at atomic and subatomic scales.

concepts.name: Cell Structure
concepts.description: The overall organization and components of a cell, including its membrane and internal structures.

concepts.name: Organelles
concepts.description: Specialized subunits within a cell that perform distinct functions, such as the nucleus and mitochondria.

concepts.name: Nucleus
concepts.description: The membrane-bound organelle that houses the cell's genetic material.

concepts.name: Mitochondria
concepts.description: The organelle responsible for producing ATP through cellular respiration.

concepts.name: Endoplasmic Reticulum
concepts.description: A network of membranes involved in protein and lipid synthesis and transport.

concepts.name: Golgi Apparatus
concepts.description: An organelle that modifies, sorts, and packages proteins for secretion.

concepts.name: Cell Membrane
concepts.description: The lipid bilayer that encloses the cell, regulating entry and exit of substances.

concepts.name: Cytoplasm
concepts.description: The gel-like substance inside the cell that contains organelles.

concepts.name: Prokaryotic Cells
concepts.description: Cells lacking a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles.

concepts.name: Eukaryotic Cells
concepts.description: Cells containing a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles.

concepts.name: Cell Division
concepts.description: The process by which a cell replicates its contents and splits into daughter cells.

concepts.name: Mitosis
concepts.description: A type of cell division resulting in two genetically identical daughter cells.

concepts.name: Meiosis
concepts.description: A type of cell division that produces four genetically diverse gametes.

concepts.name: Cellular Respiration
concepts.description: The set of metabolic pathways that convert glucose and oxygen into ATP.

concepts.name: Glycolysis
concepts.description: The anaerobic breakdown of glucose into pyruvate, yielding a small amount of ATP.

concepts.name: Citric Acid Cycle
concepts.description: A series of reactions in the mitochondria that oxidize acetyl‑CoA to produce NADH, FADH2, and ATP.

concepts.name: Electron Transport Chain
concepts.description: A chain of protein complexes that uses electrons to generate a proton gradient for ATP synthesis.

concepts.name: Photosynthesis
concepts.description: The process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose.

concepts.name: Light‑Dependent Reactions
concepts.description: The photosynthetic reactions that convert light energy into chemical energy (ATP and NADPH).

concepts.name: Calvin Cycle
concepts.description: The set of reactions that fix carbon dioxide into glucose using ATP and NADPH.
